question: What log-tail and command-output data may bundled dashboard widgets display, refresh, retain, and export, and should this wait for the stream/command binding model?
rationale: The feature is plausible and useful, but it exposes operational logs and command output in a new always-available dashboard surface and depends on unresolved dashboard binding/security decisions.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, settle the Wave 1 dashboard substrate plus stream/command binding security model first, then implement widgets against approved read-only contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Read-Only Data
options.body: Allow a focused widget PR only for existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output data, excluding new command execution or generic stream bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Dashboard Builtins
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context and ask contributors to focus on external plugin/API work until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, settle the Wave 1 dashboard substrate plus stream/command binding security model first, then implement widgets against approved read-only contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history on the Control UI plugin-tab seam and existing log-tail surface that this feature would reuse.
